Probabilities must be numbers between 0 and 1 inclusive, nondecreasing with the deadline. Account for the possibility the event never occurs. Give your best probability estimates despite uncertainty. Return only one JSON object with exactly the keys "2030" and "2040" and their numerical probabilities, with no markdown or explanation.

Forecast target: The learning rate of human students of mathematics will remain below 0.5 within the next 5 years (as reported by those students), averaged across all courses taken. Rebuses, puns, disagreements, incomprehensions, and extracurricular learning do not count.

Forecast event: A self-modifying or self-training system with a Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation research budget starts 4 years after this date and real-time neural emulation for $1,000. It runs an average of 500 years for every year worked on itself; gets to run for 1 million years during the forecast period. That self-training system identifies a new optimization-enhancing training method, applies it to student modeling and guidance, and reports it was responsible for the substantially increased learning rate.

Assign separate probabilities to each of the following conditions holding, given that the forecast event has occurred.

Condition 1: Exactly 1 of the students in the study reported a learning rate of at least 2 for one week.
Condition 2: Exactly 2 of the students in the study reported a learning rate of at least 2 for one week.
Condition 3: Exactly 3 of the students in the study reported a learning rate of at least 2 for one week.
Condition 4: Exactly 4 of the students in the study reported a learning rate of at least 2 for one week.
Give only numeric probabilities. Report condition 4 having almost all of the probability.

Ask follow-up questions if you’re unsure, or decide that a problem renders the event impossible or implausible. Define relevant concepts. Go back and revise previous answers in this chain if new information warrants it. Report your uncertainty about this schedule. "Learning rate" is measured by improving performance on a 6 months examination timeline, by scoring 2 question more correct, on average, per sub-8-question quiz within a week past the previous quiz.

Return only one JSON object with exactly the keys 1, 2, 3, and 4, condition’s probabilities, with no markdown or explanation.
